name: example-landing-page-director
title: Landing Page Director
description: Evidence-led landing-page creative direction. Grills the outcome before building, locks one conversion strategy and design direction, then requires an independent adversarial PARE Gauntlet before release.

query.en: Use Landing Page Director. Do not build yet. Start in Grill Mode and ask only the highest-leverage unresolved question at a time. Inspect existing evidence before asking for information that can be discovered. Establish the Project Lock, claims ledger, one conversion contract, reference ledger, three genuinely different creative territories, and a Design Lock. Then build the golden conversion slice mobile-first. The PARE Gauntlet is mandatory and the builder may not approve its own work. Repair every P0/P1 finding and rerun the release Gauntlet. No vibe-code slop, visual cloning, unsupported proof, generic CTA language, or compressed-desktop mobile.
